suggested_issue_title: Aspose.3D FOSS for .NET: 53 of 183 tests fail on a clean checkout because testdata/ is not tracked
suggested_issue_body:
## Summary

`.gitignore` (line 8) excludes `testdata`, the directory from which the test suite reads its fixture files, and no file under it is tracked. On a clean checkout `dotnet test` therefore reports 53 failures out of 183 tests; 47 of them are `FileNotFoundException` for fixtures under `testdata/`.

## Environment

- Repository: aspose-3d-foss/Aspose.3D-FOSS-for-.NET
- Revision: `52b0f00ebf28a0b4173921725ff170685ec2c502` (the upstream revision this report was verified against, default branch `main`)
- Windows 11, .NET SDK 10.0.401 (net10.0)
- Verified on 2026-10-11 from a fresh shallow clone.

## Steps to reproduce

```
git clone https://github.com/aspose-3d-foss/Aspose.3D-FOSS-for-.NET
cd Aspose.3D-FOSS-for-.NET
grep -n testdata .gitignore
git ls-files | grep -i -c testdata
dotnet test src/test/Aspose.ThreeD.Tests/Aspose.ThreeD.Tests.csproj
```

## Expected

The test suite passes on a clean checkout: the fixtures are tracked or the tests generate them.

## Actual

`grep` prints `8:testdata`, the second command prints `0`, and the run ends with:

```
Failed!  - Failed:    53, Passed:   130, Skipped:     0, Total:   183 (net10.0)
```
The 47 file errors name, for example: `Test file not found: ../../../../../../testdata/input/cube.obj` (6 tests), `testdata/stl/stl_ascii.stl` (5), `testdata/gltf/simple_cube.gltf` (4), `testdata/3mf/box.3mf` (3) and `./collada/cube_triangulate.dae` (3).

## Where in the repository

- `.gitignore:8` (`testdata`)
- `src/test/Aspose.ThreeD.Tests/` (the tests that read the fixtures)

## Suggested fix

Remove `testdata` from `.gitignore` and commit the fixture files, or build the fixtures inside the tests.
